in_marathi.name: Viransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Viransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vir', meaning brave, and 'Ansh', meaning essence or existence. In Hindu mythology, 'Vir' is a common epithet for various gods and goddesses, symbolizing strength and power.
